texts.author: Abū Ḥāmid al-Ghazālī

texts.author: Ibn Rushd
texts.note: Bilingual scholarly reading edition with 258 authorial sections plus colophon, 416 aligned passages, explanatory notes, and selected classical dictionary excerpts. AI-assisted, not manuscript-collated.

texts.title: al-Baḥr al-Madīd

texts.note: Translation project exists separately; not yet migrated into this repository. A limited scholarly reader preview is now available; source corpus still awaits import.

texts.title: Sharḥ al-Mawāqif
texts.author: al-Jurjānī
texts.note: Separate ongoing translation; not yet migrated into this repository. A limited scholarly reader preview is now available; source corpus still awaits import.

texts.title: Bidāyat al-Mujtahid
texts.author: Ibn Rushd
texts.note: Two edition research previews. Each now includes the recovered separate 25-case alternative-uṣūl casebook (12 full dossiers, 13 supplemental reviews, 115 source records); Edition II includes separate formation hypotheses. The canonical Revision16 primary text and 310/279 research registers remain unavailable and unimported.

texts.title: Tahdhīb al-Kalām
texts.author: Saʿd al-Dīn al-Taftāzānī
texts.note: 81 source-ordered provisional translation units drawn from a larger 140-unit research register. Contains gaps and reconstructed readings; not a complete or definitive critical edition.

texts.title: Taqrīb al-Marām fī Sharḥ Tahdhīb al-Kalām
texts.arabic: تقريب المرام في شرح تهذيب الكلام
texts.author: ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Sanandajī
texts.note: 11 selected image-checked commentary extracts, including the preface, doctrinal epistemology, causation, and divine purposes; continuous two-volume translation remains outstanding.

research.title: Bidāya–Ḍarūrī
research.note: A multi-text research synthesis using Ibn Rushd’s al-Ḍarūrī and Bidāyat al-Mujtahid; not a separate book, and not a complete translation of Bidāya.
